_comment: Chains of questions, each filed under the one above it (docs/phase5-apply-agent-spec.md 7.3, 'As built'). 'parent' is the first question (a Yes/No choice), 'children' are the questions after it in page order, and 'never' says, for each child, whether the app may offer to save an answer to it (false) or must leave it for the student (true). A child that is follow-up shaped (a follow-up wording, under six words, or one that opens with a question word) passes a never-storable chain on to the next one even when its own wording does not read as a follow-up, so a grandchild is never storable too. An independent question is not: only the child right after it is read on the parent. apply_classify (field_net through build_plan) and the engine's scan (netReadings) must agree on every child they both read; tests/test_apply_broad_net.py and tests/extension/suites/reusable_and_sensitive.mjs run this file.
